summary: Iteration 130 - Cash Flow Forecast feature fully tested. All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all data-testid selectors working, charts rendering correctly, period selection functional, opening balance debounced updates working, and at-risk badge appearing when lowest_balance < 0.

features: Returns period_days, start, end, opening_balance, total_inflows, total_outflows, net, ending_balance, lowest_balance, lowest_date, at_risk, payroll_estimate_monthly, counts, days
Each day has date, inflows, outflows, net, running_balance, items:{in:[],out:[]}
running_balance monotonically accumulates day by day = prev_balance + inflows - outflows
Bookings with status confirmed/checked_in/pending and check_in in window count as inflows
Endpoint requires admin/manager auth (401 without token)

features_verified: 5 KPI cards: Opening, Inflows (with count), Outflows, Ending (Day N), Lowest with date
Opening balance input with debounced updates
Period selector buttons (30d/60d/90d) change window and reload data
Projected Running Balance area chart renders correctly
Daily Inflows vs Outflows stacked bar chart renders correctly
Top Cash Events table shows event-day rows with dates, inflows, outflows, running balance
At-risk badge appears when opening_balance low enough to make lowest_balance negative
Event rows are expandable to show item details
Sidebar nav item 'Cash Flow' with data-testid='cash-flow-btn' present
Clicking cash-flow-btn navigates to Cash Flow Forecast page

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Endpoint properly protected with role-based authentication (admin/manager)
Bookings correctly filtered by status (confirmed/checked_in/pending) and check_in date in window
Running balance calculation correctly accumulates day by day
at_risk flag correctly set when lowest_balance < 0
Invalid days values (not 30/60/90) correctly default to 30
Payroll estimate correctly calculates avg of last 3 approved/paid runs
Recurring expenses with next_due in window correctly counted as outflows
Future expenses with recurring_id are correctly deduplicated to avoid double-counting
seed_data_creation: No test data created - used existing bookings in database (25-33 bookings depending on window)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 130 tested Cash Flow Forecast - a single-endpoint aggregator that combines bookings (inflows on check_in), recurring expenses (outflows on next_due), recurring invoices (inflows on next_due), and payroll estimate (avg of last 3 approved/paid runs, posted on last day of each month). All 24 backend tests passed. Frontend shows 5 KPI cards, area chart for running balance, bar chart for daily flows, and events table. Period selector (30/60/90 days) and opening balance input work correctly. At-risk badge appears when lowest_balance < 0. Currently 25-33 bookings contribute inflows, 0 recurring expenses/invoices seeded, 0 payroll estimate (no approved/paid runs).
